title: Black Christians Stuck in Delusional Orbiting Cycles of Stupidity

sense.text:
“For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning”. We got to understand that the scriptures, this Bible, it was written for our learning -- and our learning means the Israelites. It ain't talking about the whole world. Paul was preaching to the Israelites that was in Rome.

“that we through patience” -- we can't rush this thing. We on God's time, not our time.

“and comfort of the scriptures” -- the scriptures is what's going to give us comfort. It is telling us everything is going to be all right. It's telling us that the people going to talk about you, they're going to make memes about you, they're going to make shorts about you, they're going to make AI videos about you. But the comfort is of the scriptures -- not of our own minds, not of Bishop Nathanyel's mind or Bishop Yawasap's mind or Bishop Kani's mind, not of the deacons' or the captains' mind, but of the scriptures, through the word of God.

“might have hope.” That's where our faith is at: that we know that we are the children of Israel, and through patience and comfort of the scriptures we may have hope. If you looking at this right now, thank God that you have come out of the Christian church. Those people are delusional, and there's no magic scripture you got that can change their mind. It's going to take the Lord to change their mind. So there ain't no use sitting around debating about whether God is one or three, no use sitting around with no HBI talking about whether we should have wives and concubines. It ain't no use.

“Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times” -- the latter times is talking about now, 2025 and beyond, at the end.

“some shall depart from the faith”. A lot of people have departed from the faith. The faith is Christ.

“giving heed to seducing spirits”. This is why when you cut on TikTok, everybody got their arrows, they got their guns, they got their fists, everything is pointed at the purple and gold. The purple and gold has become the standard of the true teachings of the Israelites. It's stamped right now. A lot of people don't like it, a lot of people have been trying to stop it, but it's the standard. You wear purple and gold -- no, you're not a Lakers fan, you ain't a Que dog, you must be one of them damn Israelites, ain't you? That's how they looking at us now.

“and doctrines of devils” -- doctrines of the deceivers. A lot of times you going to be seduced by these doctrines of the deceivers.

“Speaking lies in hypocrisy”. That's the delusion that our people are in. They believe in a lie. They believe Santa Claus is really coming to town. And black people try to get smart now and say, oh man, we don't just believe that -- but you're teaching your children. You're allowing the school system to teach your children, you're allowing the black church to teach your children, that Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer got a very shiny nose. We are in a delusional mindset because we have been conditioned to love white supremacy. Every Christmas they wanted to be white. They dreaming of a white Christmas.

That's what our people love to hear: the lies that America has taught them. And when we come out to tell them that Santa Claus ain't real, that Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer ain't real, that the twelve days of Christmas ain't real, they call us the cult, they say we the bad guys. All them negroes that was laughing and chilling on Thursday still got doodoo on their breath. The doodoo is the sin that you in: sometime it come out your mouth, sometime it come out your other end, but it's all in your body. Thank the Lord that you repented. No pork in twelve years now, no cigarette, no blunt, none of that -- why? Because of the word of God. If I was still calling myself a black Christian I would have ate chitlins and I'd be up here right now smelling like doodoo.

And they love to hear the lies. Chitlins ain't bad, man. Eating hog booty ain't bad. Just clean them out real good, put some potatoes in the pot, put some onions in there, put a boiled egg in there and it hold the smell down. Some of the people I grew up with take pride in eating chitlins -- one negro ate chitlins all day Thursday and got up Friday morning and posted his breakfast plate on the internet, eggs, a piece of sausage, a piece of toast, and chitlins with some hot sauce on it. That's unclean. And it's always funny to black people till it ain't funny. They'll keep on eating chitlins until they laying up with gout and can't even walk, until he got high blood pressure, until she got breast cancer, until he got prostate cancer, until he got heart disease -- then it ain't funny, then that's when they want to try to call on the Lord. No. Call on Santa Claus. Call on Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer -- them your gods. Call on Rudolph to come save you; he got wings, he can fly to the sky, he get there overnight. That's what you need to call on. Don't call on our God when we sitting up here trying to tell y'all to repent right now.

“in hypocrisy”. They'll tell you not to do something and they doing it themselves. The white man say everybody's created equal, but you. Everybody's created equal, but you Hispanics. If everybody's created equal, why they got a damn ICE detention center? If everybody was created equal, why did we have to go through Jim Crow and the black codes? If everybody was created equal, why are the white communities not turned upside down like the black communities? But black people still think they going to vote their way into equality. It ain't going to happen. And when the politicians are trying to get votes, the first place they go is to the black church. Bill Clinton done it. All the politicians have done it. Even Donald Trump done it. He finds the preacher with the biggest mouth and the biggest church and he go act like he like black people for a minute, and they'll lay hands over him and pray like they got the Holy Ghost and touch on the president, and the president sitting there like he praying with black folk, thinking, no man, I just need y'all vote -- really just to keep them in the American delusion, because their vote don't matter anyway. It's already set up who gonna be the president and what mission God got them on.

“having their conscience seared with a hot iron”. That's the way they think, what they have been taught. It's like you burn your shirt with an iron. Plenty of people have, especially with the purple shirts -- we be at camp sometime, and me as a captain I'm walking through the line like, bro, you don't see all the damn holes on the back of your shirt? And he always blame it on his wife. But the thing is, you can't get it out. You cannot get that out once it has been seared in your shirt. The best thing you can do is throw it away and buy another.

That's how it is when it comes to the black Christian church, and some of these HBI camps and some of these individuals that hate us. They speak lies and hypocrisy. They'll say, well, we don't hate IUIC -- but all your videos got IUIC's name in them, they got purple and gold in their thumbnail, it got something to do with your hatred towards IUIC, if not hating on Bishop Nathanyel. And they'll say, we don't hate them dudes, man, them our brothers. Y'all can miss us with that crap. We don't look at you like that no more. Everybody the enemy until you prove otherwise. Right now everybody the enemy. It's us against the world. So when we see you, if we don't salute you, it ain't because we don't love you. We ain't falling for that 'them my brothers' talk: y'all say one thing, then go do another. You brothers battling a spirit of envy, a spirit of covetousness, a spirit of lust -- lusting after the money. Everything's about money, about views, about clickbait. People making videos when they know what we're saying is right. In their spirit they know we saying right. We hear it all the time on Clubhouse: people come on, they know what we're saying is right, but they are in the delusion that they got to be right. A lot of these dudes in the Israelite community know we're right, but they don't want us to be right, because they want people to follow them so they can get more views to their page.

So why would we sit up here and debate them? What is a debate going to do at the end of the day? They going to go right back to believing their own minds, and the scriptures just said their minds are seared with a hot iron, what they believe in. So what a debate gonna do? Because we know that we got the truth. We know what we're saying is right. So what we going to sit up here and debate if it's three gods or one for? We know the Bible says it is two. It's no three. It's two. We keep reading and keep reading it. So what we going to go sit down and debate for? The Bible says one wife. Christ said one wife. What we going to sit down and debate for? You going to go home, kick all the rest of them out the house and just leave one wife? You ain't going to do that. You going to continue in your folly. You're not going to repent. So what we going to sit up there and debate y'all for? It wouldn't even make no sense. What you need to do is continue to teach what you think is the truth, the word of God, and we'll see what happens in the end. We not gonna see eye to eye right now. When Christ come back, he gonna lay the smackdown. He gonna lay everything out on the table on what we need to do in order to live in this kingdom.

“Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets”. That she is wisdom. The deacon's class the other night showed who that she is: she is Christ.

So wisdom is her voice. This is the wisdom of Christ, the wisdom of the Most High God -- not the wisdom of this world.

“She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words”. When we out, we're crying in the chief place of concourse. We're crying out in the streets, we're crying out at the barber shops, at the high schools, at the community centres, on social media, on Clubhouse.

In the city she uttereth her words -- in every city. All the major cities on this earth right now are hearing the gospel. I can't say the little ones, because some places the gospel just ain't going to get there, but the majority of all the major cities are hearing it.

Thank the Lord for IUIC, that we don't have leaders who are just sitting in Harlem, just sitting in Jersey, just sitting in LA, just sitting in Chicago, just sitting in Tennessee or just sitting in Georgia talking about they preaching the gospel and not doing what Christ said: go to all the nations, teaching them that the kingdom of heaven is at hand and we must repent.

“How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity?” How long you black Christians going to be simple? How long y'all going to continue to celebrate Thanksgiving? Simplicity in America's white supremacist system -- that's simplicity. A bunny don't lay eggs. You know Santa Claus ain't coming to town. You know that Thanksgiving is about the pilgrims killing the Indians. How long you going to love simplicity? You know you ain't got no damn money, but you going to shop on Black Friday to get them bad ass kids some stuff for Christmas when they been bad all year, cussed out the teacher at the school and cussed you out.

I hope them dudes don't come on the internet ever again talking about a Yahawah day, sitting around eating pig, pork, eating hog jaws, the hog ball, the hog everything, the hog head, hog head cheese. Eating swine on Thanksgiving saying it's Yahawashi day. The leader of that camp, fat, out of shape. He done convinced the people that it's cool to be fat and out of shape and you can put whatever in your body. Man, how in the world can you pick up the Bible and read it and think that the Bible will condone such a sin as that? Your mind have been seared with a hot iron, full of lies and hypocrisy.

Black women think they've been a good mother as long as they buy their kids some damn Jordans for Christmas, and leave them at home by themselves all year round. Black fathers think they doing a hell of a job as long as they can buy their kids some Jordans and a PlayStation 5. That don't make you a good parent, because you can buy your kids something for Christmas. What makes you a good parent is when you teach your children the law, statutes and commandments of God -- when you learn this for yourself, keep them, learn your identity, who you are in the Bible, and teach it to your kids. Not what you can buy them. A lot of women go broke, a lot of men go broke, trying to buy them kids something for Christmas.

How long means: when are you going to wake up? What dispensation of time is it going to take? How much oppression? How many butt whoopings? Captivity after captivity after captivity -- and that's how I know that we are God's chosen people. The Lord delivered us out of Egypt, we went right back into sin. The Lord delivered us out of Babylon, we went right back to sin. And he did it with a mighty hand, a powerful hand, so that it could never be seen or thought of that these people was going to get out of these captivities -- but the Lord had to send his prophets down and deliver them with a mighty hand. After Babylon we went into Persia and the Medes. The people couldn't see us getting out of that, but the Lord delivered us; he sent his prophets to deliver us. Then after Persia and the Medes we went into the Greek. They was killing us. They made us conform, made us become Greeks, made us become Gentiles, and if not they would put us to death, put our fathers to death, the mothers to death; you circumcise your kids, they put you and the kid to death. Then after Greece we went into Rome captivity.

And tonight is the beginning of the feast of dedication. When we were in the Greek captivity the Lord had to send deliverers, he had to send saviours -- shout out to the tribe of Levi -- to deliver us and get our temple back, to rededicate the temple back to the Most High God and the children of Israel. That is what the feast of dedication is about. But the black Christian don't know nothing about the feast of dedication. They know about Thanksgiving and Christmas, Black Friday, chitlins, hog maws, greens, black-eyed peas -- everything the slave master taught them. They don't know nothing about what God taught us to celebrate. And the vast majority of the high holy days in the Bible that the Lord tells us to keep are about deliverance, about us going from one state to another, from being slaves, from being captives, to being free. One reason the black church don't know nothing about it is because Christianity is set up on white supremacy, and when you got a white supremacist teaching you about your book, they going to make up some stuff to keep you from reading the book. They not going to tell you who you are in the book, so you won't understand what salvation is and who salvation is for. That's their job. Satan doing his job.

“and the scorners delight in their scorning”. So we dealing with the black Christians who are in a delusional mind state and they turning on an orbiting cycle of stupidity. We dealing with these people every day and we handling them very well. We got warriors in IUIC, from the bishop all the way down to the soldiers to the YMOV. Some of these young brothers can handle some of these apologists like Vocab and God Logic, and we ain't even sicked them on them yet -- but we keep our kids out of it. There was one young kid they tried to sic on our kids, and the young prophets in Atlanta got on his head on YouTube and TikTok.

And look at what the black Christian church is raising: three little kids in a store stealing, one of them acting just like a girl, dressed like their mama, and the woman locked the door on them, so they start turning up the store. Them little kids that beat up their parents up there in Chicago, and it happened again this past week in another city, a woman and her daughter and the kids jumped on her. These be the little black Christians, the little black demons that the apologetics want us to go back to so bad. They don't like us teaching our kids the Bible, got our young men standing up in formation, teaching them how to be soldiers, teaching them thou shalt not steal, teaching our young men to be masculine and not feminine, teaching our young girls to be feminine and not masculine. They hate that. That's why they trying to stop what we're teaching, because they are stuck in a delusional state. They think what they're doing is right, and they so in a delusion that they can't see that what we're doing is benefiting the community. If they could see, they would say, you know what, I don't like them guys in the purple, but at least they getting men off the street at an enormous rate. These young men stopped gang banging; the gang initiation has dropped; single-parent households have dropped. They're teaching marriage. The Bible says marriage is honourable and that's what we teach. But no -- y'all, the law is done away with. They delusional. You got pastors against us with a daughter right now who got five, six, nine, ten kids with eight different baby daddies, and she destroyed; and you got the men in purple and gold teaching, don't do that, sis, keep your legs closed, you're going to destroy the next generation, you're going to destroy the kids you just had.

But no, you listening to your Christian pastor, your granddaddy. He say, well, you ain't got to keep the law -- just so we can eat some hog ass for Thanksgiving. He want to eat some hog jaws. He want to put fat back in his white beans, the tin so old it's yellow, with that good hog salt in it. Just so we can eat swine's flesh, just so that woman pastor want to eat a damn crab or seafood so bad. She'll say that the laws of God is done away with. She got to show the crack of her behind so bad. She got to show the crack of her behind so bad, and she'll say that the laws of God is done away with and we can do what we want to do. All we got to do is believe and call on the name of Jesus.

“Turn you at my reproof”. The Bible says to turn you at my correction. That's what we are here to do: trying to get this black church to see that what we're doing is correct. Even if you don't like us, what we're doing is right, what we're saying is correct.

If you think God, Christ and the Holy Ghost is one person walking on the earth, that God hung himself on the cross -- if that's what you believe, so be it. Believe that. Go somewhere and teach it. We should see the fruits of that. If you believe that, we should see some good fruit, because we see some bad fruit. If you don't believe that we got to keep the laws of God, do that -- we should see the good fruits of that.

But you cannot deny that what we're teaching is changing the mindsets of the community. Changing the mindset of men who were whoremongers, women who were straight up strippers, the men who was smoking weed, selling cocaine, selling fentanyl to people, scamming people -- men and women. These people repenting. They no longer in your grandmama's inbox trying to get her social security check. I guess if we were getting in grandmama's inbox and beating her out of her money, everything going to be okay in the name of Jesus. But we teaching repentance. We turning scammers into repentance, and they don't like that.

precepts.why:
“Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings”. That is what a lot of y'all Christians got to do. The Bible said they need to do what? Wash you. Wash them.

Get them flushed out. Some of them eat them damn chitlins and won't even do no cleanse. They go from chitlins to Hennessy to smoking blunts and cigarettes. That's why we be dying at the age we be, thirty-five, with all kind of cancers. They don't even do no cleanse.

“put away the evil of your doings”. The Bible says you got to put away the evil of your doings. And black people are delusional about it -- you smell it stinking, you know it's funky, and you eat it anyway. Like eating crab and seafood: it be so funky they got to put gloves on to eat it, because they know if they go to work the next day their fingers gonna be smelling. They got to put a hazmat suit on to eat this stuff. And they'll sit there and eat it with their long eyelashes and weaves and think they doing something because they seen a celebrity on TV do it. It's funky, and that's how you know we are delusional, and it's black Christians doing it. Black Muslims don't eat the pork, they don't eat all that. It's always the black Christian woman.

sense.text:
“But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day”. These are the scriptures the black church would not read inside of the black church, because they think they are hearkening to the voice of the Lord God. That's why they in the delusional mindset thinking chitlins are good and seafood boils are good.

“that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee”. All these curses. Black people got to understand that we are under a curse. The black pastor, the black bishop, the black ministers, the black evangelists have got to understand that we are in a curse.

So quit trying to fix us through the political way. We can't vote our way out of this. We didn't vote our way into this.

“The Lord shall smite thee with madness”. Madness. This is what we're seeing inside of the black Christian church. Madness. Madness is going into us being out of our right minds, and madness is going into us being angry as well. Black people gone full-blown spiritually sick.

Y'all ever wonder -- you go to every city and you see one of our people and we always say, man, back in the day he was one of the smartest dudes, he was the best drug dealer in the world, he had money, but the Lord smitten him with madness. Or somebody you went to school with, they was in their right mind in school, but you see them now and they are smitten with madness, walking in the road, done messed on themselves, doing all type of stuff. Which is not funny, because it's sad. And that's how the Christian church is. They have been smitten with madness.

Here is some of that madness. A woman at a funeral, bent over in a dead man's face, doing the splits, encouraged by the people, and nobody said nothing -- and they was at the black church, the black church who's coming up against the Israelites. You'll never see nothing like that at an Israelite funeral. If we catch a ratchet woman that came out the street -- I don't care if it was your sister, it could have been your mama -- she not going to bring that ratchet behaviour into a homegoing. We tell the deacon to step back, Bishop sit down, don't say nothing, we got it. They ain't bringing shame back, and we going to make the news when we do it.

And here is more of it. A pastor with some water in a bottle: it look clear in the bottle, but when he spray it, it turn yellow. They think they putting mustard or food colouring in the water, but that ain't just no water, that ain't H2O, that's H2O and urine, and he's spraying this woman, and she acting, screaming and jumping around. They think this man got some kind of power. Y'all better quit playing with the Lord. So where are the apologetics making videos against this pastor? Why y'all want to keep messing with us about the Trinity, about the law, about the Gentiles -- what about this witchcraft that's going on in the black church? We are under a delusion. White supremacy has set in with the black Christian church.

“and blindness”. The Lord shall smite thee with madness and blindness. They can't see what we're doing, how we are being very beneficial to the community. How we know is that they hate the purple and gold. We put on other colours and have different community events and people love us. When you put that purple and gold on -- boy, oh hell, here they come.

precepts.why:
“Having the understanding darkened”. Their understanding have been darkened: with white supremacy, with politics, the music industry, the entertainment world -- everything. They don't want to hear the Bible. They want to hear or see some form of entertainment to make them feel good. They want the political system to make them feel good, to lie to them, to tell them everything going to be all right.

“being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them”. Through the ignorance that is in them.

“because of the blindness of their heart”. Because of the blindness of their mind. It said the Lord shall smite thee with blindness: they can't see what's really going on. They can't see the simplicity that's in Christ.

“But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty” -- through his trickery, his cunning games. That's how he beguiled Eve, and he done the same thing with us: through his trickery, through his political system, through his entertainment system, through his religious system.

“so your minds should be corrupted”. Now the black church's mind have been corrupted. “from the simplicity that is in Christ” -- from the simple things that you are supposed to understand about Christ.

You don't even understand the colour of Christ. Oh, it don't matter what colour he is. Nobody was there, no one seen him, no one knows what Jesus looked like. That's just simple. That's the simplicity of Christ: simple things, like what he looked like.

sense.text:
“He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.” It said that you must believe on Christ. This is Christ speaking: believe on him as the scripture hath said.

As the scripture hath said. So if it's written in the Bible that Christ is a black man, you cannot say it don't matter. These are simple things, like what he looked like, and you can't say it don't matter if it's in the Bible. He wrote it in there for a reason.

For you to say it don't matter what your forefathers looked like, that's an evil spirit upon you. Don't you know that our forefathers died for us? That's like saying a hundred years from now it don't matter that Martin Luther King was a white man, that Martin Luther King was Danny DeVito, a little short white man, an actor. No, that ain't true. Martin Luther King died for the people. That's like saying Malcolm X was John Travolta. How you going to just make that up and say it don't matter? And y'all keep letting white people use their white supremacy to erase black history.

This is what it's going to come to. They going to stop us from teaching that Jesus Christ is black. They already got critical race theory going on, where you can't talk about slavery. They don't want us talking about the civil rights movement, the black codes, Jim Crow. They don't want us talking about the atrocities that white people have done to black people, so they could change the history -- not for the kids living now, for your grandkids' grandkids. And they going to start locking us up and fining us for it too, for even saying that Martin Luther King was a black man. They going to fire you off your job. If you want to talk about Malcolm X, about Eldridge Cleaver, about Bobby Seale and Huey Newton, about Assata Shakur -- that's how it's going to be, because they going to change the narrative of what they done to us, to keep black people, the black church, in the delusion that everything is equal and everything is going to be all right. Just be our servants. Just continue to serve us, continue to make us rich, because without y'all being ignorant and delusional my grandchildren don't have a future. If you start to wake the black people up, that means my grandchildren don't have a future.

They are rebuilding America right before our very eyes. They tear down these old buildings; right here in Tennessee, in the cities, they letting them just dilapidate. They let negroes be the mayor, be under the city council, knowing that fifteen, twenty years from now the negroes didn't have a chance. Now they have figured out, we going to move out of town, let them have this, and we going to move to the city where the money is at. They rebuilding the cities right under our nose, knocking down wooded areas and rural areas -- the deer ain't got nowhere to go but into the front of your car and get smacked. And they building it not for them; they know that they going to die. They building it for their grandkids' grandkids' grandkids, while we just sitting around watching them build it, waiting on the damn Super Bowl, waiting to see if NBA YoungBoy gonna have a concert in town, waiting on the NBA finals and how many points LeBron going to score. They playing chess, we playing checkers. They give us the Bible and tell us to jump around and spray piss on each other.

precepts.why:
“Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come”. This is the last time. This is the last days. Antichrist -- that means the people that are against Christ. They are here and they have been ruling, and they're trying to continue their rulership.

And who's interrupting it? The Israelites. The guys in the purple and gold. We're interrupting the antichrist agenda. Understand that they had the black Christian church wrapped around their finger for years, for decades, for centuries, for hundreds of years, after they enslaved us. During slavery and after slavery they had the black church wrapped around their finger, had them going in the direction they should be going in order to keep their children's children rich, to keep themselves at the top. And then here they come in purple, marching down the street trying to tell them that the white man is goddamn devil and he is a liar; Santa Claus ain't real; you should not be celebrating Thanksgiving; Halloween is fake; Valentine's Day is fake; the new year ain't the new year; stop celebrating your birthday, that's idolatry. They are trying to tell the blacks to stop spending money. Here we come interrupting their program.

“even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.” Many antichrists. And guess what, they black, they white, they Chinese, they Hispanic. It's many. And that's how we know that it's the last time, the last days.

“Beloved, believe not every spirit”. He's telling us don't believe every spirit. This is why it's important, it's very important, to understand that the colour of Christ matters -- because behind a false image is a false spirit. Say it again: behind a false image is a false spirit. If a hundred years from now, when we are dead and gone, they show that Martin Luther King was a white man, do you think what else they tell you about black history and what Martin Luther King done is going to be true? No, because behind the image is going to be a spirit of lying, conniving, hypocrisy.

So if I tell you that Jesus Christ is a white man -- and they didn't make him Chinese, they didn't make him East Indian, they didn't say he was a pale Arab colour, they ain't draw no dot in the middle of his head. This is who they pray to; this is who they think is Jesus. Black people have been tricked into believing this spirit. I hate when I be at camp and a woman walks up with her kids and we ask the kids, who is that? They all point to the white man: that's Jesus. Then we look up at the parent standing there looking stupid -- oh, I know that ain't Jesus, I know Jesus look more like that. Well, why you ain't been teaching it then? Because they delusional and they afraid of white supremacy. If they do know, they don't even care to teach the children.

“but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.” You got to try the spirit. A lot of times when you start a conversation with a Christian, especially a black Christian, they talking about they saved, they sanctified, they fire baptized and they filled with the Holy Ghost -- they know how to do all that. But the Bible says you got to try the spirit. Try it with the simplicity that's in Christ: just ask them, what colour is Christ, before you even have a conversation about Jesus. Try them and see if they are of God. One of them Mormons walking around the neighbourhood -- hi, my name is Elder Joey, you want to talk about Jesus? Yeah, what colour is he? Well, it doesn't matter. Oh, they let you know that's the spirit of antichrist. So when you're talking to your auntie or your uncle about Jesus, say, hey, what colour is he? Let's just see if we can admit first that he look like us. Then try the doctrine. Do we got to keep the law? See what doctrine they rolling in, because Christ taught that we got to keep the law. We no longer have to keep the sacrificial law, because he was the ultimate sacrifice, but he did teach that we have to keep the law. See what spirit they are rolling in.

That's why when we talking to the apologetics, these dumb dumbs like God Logic, some dude named Marcus -- I can't remember all these dudes, I can't keep up with them -- they trying to get famous, they trying to be content creators, and they trying to use the purple and the gold, they trying to use IUIC to gain more views. How about let's debate on the colour of Christ? What did Christ really look like when he walked the earth? Don't say that he was a spirit nailed to the cross. When they took him off the cross and put him in the tomb, they ain't go looking for no spirit in the tomb. The family didn't go looking for no spirit; they were looking for a man that was in the tomb. So for them to say that Christ is a spirit, y'all need to run.

So many false prophets have gone out into the world. Like the Book of Clarence -- if y'all ever watch the Book of Clarence, you'll see it was a lot of people trying to play like they was the Messiah. A lot of people was playing like they were Messiah. They come in the clubhouse room. Freaking Jesus, throwback Jesus, a damn bargain hunt Jesus, a damn Goodwill Jesus -- they got all type of Jesus to come in the clubhouse. We want to put all them in a room and they should be able to debate. I want to see which one the real Jesus. They all come in our clubhouse room at different times; one time I think they both was on the stage at one time in another clubhouse room talking about they were Jesus. That was funny as hell. Let you know they ain't Jesus.

“Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God”. You got to confess that he come in the flesh, meaning that he had skin on him. Your flesh is your skin. So part of the confession is what he looked like, how he talked, how he sounded -- did Jesus talk soft, or did he have a voice as many waters? You got to confess that he came in the flesh, you got to confess his doctrine in which he taught, you got to confess the spirit in which he rolled.

And that's why we ain't got time to sit up here playing ring around the rosie with these dudes like God Logic and the rest of them. When they show up to the camp, blast they ass. Blast them. Don't give them a chance to damn speak. They come into the clubhouse, blast they ass. Don't give them a chance to speak, because all they doing is looking for a moment of fame. You got one dumb ass coming to the damn clubhouse trying to make a deacon look like he don't know what he talking about. All they want is a little moment of fame to get some damn YouTube views. And it don't matter if you damn kick his ass in the scriptures -- he's going to post it on his channel, put IUIC in the thumbnail, put IUIC in the title, and then strut around like he won. That's why the bishop say don't play chess with a pigeon. Don't play no games with a pigeon. Don't play basketball with him either, because you can dunk on him. You can be up fifty points, fourth quarter, three seconds to go in the game, he know he lost, the buzzer went off -- and the next day he gonna be on the news strutting around dropping doodoo on the damn basketball court talking about he won.

That's why we ain't got time to be debating y'all. Let's debate who are the real damn Jews over there in Israel. Let's debate if the white man is the real Jew or not. Who are those people over there fighting? Let's talk about who the real Jews are. What happened to the real Jews? How did they leave the land black and return white? They don't want to debate that. They want to debate stupid stuff. They want to debate if God is one or three. They want to debate if the white man can get into the kingdom of heaven. He ain't getting into heaven. He'll mess up the water. We might have some good water up there, and where the Most High gonna reset everything, you think he gonna let him mess it up again? You think he gonna let them mess up the good food again? We're gonna have good food, good vegetables again, good fruit again, some good cow meat again, some good beef, some good lamb. It ain't going to be contaminated. You think he going to let the white man up there? He going to build another damn computer and think he God; he want to know where everybody at, how much money everybody spending, and you can't spend it without his permission. He going to start thinking he God again.

“And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist”. If you don't confess that, you are not of God. You rolling in the spirit of white supremacy, you rolling in the spirit of the antichrist. Because no one had a problem when the white man, for centuries, for hundreds of years, been saying that his son was white. Nobody had no problem with it. But when you say black, now we got to sit up here and prove it. Now you prove to us that he was white. If they can't confess that, run. Get away from them. They got white Jesus on their mind, and that's what they got. This is why black people go to church every Sunday, some of them going to go tomorrow with chitlin juice on their blouse, on their dress, coming out their mouth and their ear, praying to a white man. When they close their eyes, this is what they see. That's why they fight so hard for him.

sense.text:
They always want to debate the Trinity, they always want to debate something stupid. Let's debate this scripture. Who is this scripture talking about?

“Let no man deceive you by any means”. Don't let nobody deceive you, by any means.

“for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first”. It's going to be a major setback. That setback is us going into captivity. We had to go into captivity because we disobeyed God's law, statutes and commandments. We had to be colonized. We had to be taught about a false god. We had to be taught that Jesus was white, because we didn't honour and respect the God that we had; we wanted to follow the other nations. God allowed this to happen to us. That falling away had to come first, because God is going to show his power, and he's going to show his power through us. He going to show the world that it don't matter what you do, what you teach and how you deceive the people -- when I want to change the mind of my people, I'm going to do it.

“and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition”. That man of sin be revealed. Y'all going to realize that this ain't Jesus. Black woman, y'all going to realize that this ain't Jesus. The Bible don't say Jesus look like a bathtub after you take a bath and it got that brown ring around it. Jesus didn't have no red neck. I know black people hate to hear that. He didn't have no red beard. He didn't have blue eyes. If the Bible said that, we'll be teaching that. But black people got to stop this. They really think that man is Jesus. They have been deceived. That's why he said, let no man deceive you. She crying too; she think that's Jesus. Poor thing. Well, the truth is out now, and that's why they trying to stop us. The son of perdition -- the son of destruction, the son of the damn devil. That white man laying there, that's not Jesus; that's the son of perdition.

“Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped”. And that's what they do. They oppose and they exalt themselves above all that is called God. The white man have sat up there and said that he's God. They didn't make him a Chinese god or an East Indian god or an Arabian god. They took themselves and said that they are God. Let's argue about that, God Logic. Let's argue about who done that.

“so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God”. So it says that he -- meaning it's going to be a physical man that done this. He sitteth in the temple of God, meaning he have created his own heaven.

“shewing himself that he is God.” And showing himself that he is God.

“Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?” Look, man, remember a thousand years ago when I was with you, I told y'all this was going to happen.

I don't know what's wrong with the black Christian. He already told us this was going to happen: that it was going to be a man who opposed himself as God, who was going to build his own kingdom and say he is God.

“And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.”

He's going to be revealed. And who's doing it? The Israelites, who y'all hate. We going to reveal them whether you like it or not.

“For the mystery of iniquity doth already work”. The mystery of sin is already working. He's already at work. He got you in a state of delusion, turning on your own axis, where he can just sit back. The devil sit back and let his minions do his work, let his minions do his job.

He got Hispanic people, he got the whole world thinking he is God. He put it in his movies, he put it in the magazines, he put it on the calendars, he put it all on the social media like he God. Then when we say he the devil, that ain't God, they say, nigga, y'all lie. YouTube will block the video, they'll give you a strike if you don't say Jesus is white sometime; you got to be careful how you say it.

And he's got black people confused. These apologetics got these dudes confused -- they can't wait to make another video against us. And you got one negro hugging the devil, and the devil got a shirt on that says I hate Satan. That's how you know these people are delusional. I call them coconut heads: they brown on the outside and they white on the inside. They Mr. Potato Heads. It's on the nigga's mind. He got a Christianity cross on, hugging his slave master that got a shirt on and say, I hate Satan. We need something to peel the damn potato, we need a coconut buster, we got a sledgehammer -- something need to bust the coconut head open so he can see the truth, spiritually busted open. These are the people who make videos against us. When we say the white man is the devil, we mean he is the deceiver. That's Esau himself; that's Jacob and Esau right there all over again. And we ain't telling nobody to hate white people. We don't teach nobody to hate nobody. You just got to know the deck of cards you playing with. I work with white people all the time, I don't treat them like I hate them -- I just know who I'm dealing with. And you'll find out real fast: they let something happen, they going to stick together and they going to throw your ass under the lawnmower with the blades turning.

“only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.” Until he be taken out of the way. We moving his ass now.

“And then shall that Wicked be revealed”. And then shall the wicked be revealed. Who is the wicked? The ones who have lied to us for centuries. The ones who told us that God's laws are done away with for centuries. The ones who have told us that all nations can be saved for centuries. The ones who told us that Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer had a very shiny nose for centuries. The ones who have told us that Thanksgiving is about sitting around with your family eating chitlins and hog maws and jaws and is a great thing, that it's about giving thanks. They deceived us. The ones who have told us for centuries that January the first is the new year. These people been lying to us for so long that the stupidity, the ignorance of these people, just turns on its own axis right now.

Who's revealing them? The Israelites. Even though we may not agree on certain doctrines, and all of them may hate Bishop Nathanyel and hate IUIC, one thing we are doing is revealing who the devil is. And some of them are changing their doctrine now; they got fringes and the baseball caps on and the menorah on and the six-pointed star on, a whole ball of confusion, and they want to change the doctrine and say that Esau is not going to get his judgment, that Esau can be saved.

“whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth”. He's going to consume him with the spirit of his mouth. What comes out of his mouth? The word. The word of God.

“and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”. And he's destroying with the brightness of his coming.

“And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish”. They are deceivable and they sinful and they perish -- they die.

“because they received not the love of the truth”. They did not receive the love of the truth. They did not want to keep God's commandments. The apologetics teach that we don't have to love God. The black Christian church teaches that we do not have to love God -- they say that we do not have to keep the law, we do not have to do what God say do. They don't understand that when they say we don't have to keep the law any more, they are saying we don't have to do what God say do. You don't have to love God to get into heaven? You don't have to love your father to get into his house? That's how stupid it sounds. He just gonna open the door for you; all you got to do is believe that's his house and he gonna let you in, and don't do what he say do.

Just basic scriptures run circles around the apologetics. They don't even understand what the truth is, they don't understand what the love is, they don't understand who Satan is, they don't understand who Christ is, they don't understand who the Most High God is. They do not understand the Bible. They going to regurgitate to you what their slave master have taught them for years, whether through their grandparents, through their parents, or through their religious school system.

“that they might be saved.” That they might be saved. They wanted to stay in sin. They love Thanksgiving. They love the way chitlins and crab legs smell. They love it.

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion”. For this cause -- y'all love unrighteousness, you love sin, you want to stay in it. So God is going to send them a strong delusion. He didn't say a weak delusion where they can kind of fight their way out of it. A strong delusion on their minds. It's hard for them to get out of it.

It's hard for them not to celebrate Christmas. It's hard for them not to think that Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer got a very shiny nose. It's hard for them not to remember the twelve days of Christmas. It's hard for them not to celebrate New Year's. It's hard for them not to celebrate Valentine's Day. It's hard for them not to celebrate their birthdays. It's hard for them not to celebrate Easter -- they try to change the name of it and say it's okay now, they call it resurrection day. It's hard for them not to do this because they have been lied to for so long. They say we got to get together and eat a turkey.

“that they should believe a lie”. They believe Christianity, which is a lie: that you can do what you want to. First of all, God is white -- it don't matter. Christ is white -- it don't matter. The prophets are white -- it don't matter. Until you say they black, then it just don't matter. You can eat what you want to eat, do what you want to do, wear what you want to wear, sleep with who you want to sleep with. They believe a lie. They are in a delusional orbiting cycle of stupidity.

And things are not going to get better in our communities until we come back to God's laws. That's the only way. To hell with what the apologists say, to hell with what your Christian pastor says. Things ain't going to get better until we come back to teaching God's laws. We teaching marriage, we teaching the dietary law, we teaching the civil law, and we teaching moral laws according to God, according to the Bible. This is what we're missing in the black community. Whether they like it or not, we got to continue to teach this, to hell with these stupid debates. Teach God's laws -- that's what's going to wake the people up, that's what's going to bring more men, women, teenagers and children into the body of Christ. Not no damn debates trying to figure out who's right and who's wrong. That is there to set up confusion.

precepts.why:
“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”. Edom is the so-called white man -- let's debate that, let's debate who is the white man in the Bible. And that's what they have done when they came. Alexander the Great, the Greek: there ain't nothing great about him, but that's what they told us his name was in school. Alexander the Greek, the devil, when he came out of the Caucasus Mountains and was set out to destroy and conquer all the dark nations. He came to rebuild.

“thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”. He said y'all going to build, but he will throw down. He will throw down.

“and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” They are the border of wickedness. They are the beginning and they going to be the end of all wickedness. They are the border, and the Lord is going to bring them to the end. That spirit that's in them is wicked. And the people against whom the Lord hath indignation -- that's righteous anger. The Lord has got a right to be angry with Esau, with Edom. He has got a right to be that way, because these people are opposing themselves as God, they sit up in the temple as God, and they telling the world that they are God. That's how we are even able to talk to people from one country to another -- only God is supposed to do that. They even want to know where you at at all times, what you doing, how much money you got. Only God knows that. They trying to play God. For ever: these people who run the earth, God has got a right to be angry with them for ever. That is why they have found no place of repentance. They going to be crying like a baby, but there's no place of repentance for them because they done did too much. They oppose themselves as God and they sit in the temple of God. They say they are God's people, and they cast us down and cast lots for us, put us in slavery, put us at the bottom of society, gave us drugs, gave us cocaine, gave us the gangster rap music, gave us the blaxploitation movies. They control Hollywood. They control everything that plays with the mindset of keeping black people in the delusional state, in that orbiting cycle of stupidity.

“Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished”. The Bible says though hand join in hand. God don't care about you hugging them. They still going to get what's coming to them.

God don't care about you singing kumbaya, or amazing grace how sweet the sound, or I've been born again. He don't care about you singing this little light of mine, I'm gonna let it shine. He don't care about pass me not, O gentle Saviour, do not pass me by. He don't care if you playing Lee Williams and the Spiritual QCs, riding around in the car down in the bottom of Mississippi. He don't care. Shirley Caesar, the Mighty Clouds of Joy. These people going to get judged.

I don't give a damn how many negro spirituals you can sing with these folk. The wicked shall not be unpunished. They got to get their judgment. That's what people don't understand: these people got to get judged because of what they have done to the children of Israel, to the sons of Israel, to the sons of Jacob. They got to get judged for what Esau done to his brother's kids. For what Esau done to Jacob. They got to get judged.

They receive not the love of the truth -- so what is the love? “For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments”. That is the love of God: that we keep his commandments. That we do what? Keep his commandments.

For anybody to say that we do not have to keep the commandments, that the laws of God are done away with -- they do not understand the Bible. They do not understand the Bible. Christians will make the Bible contradict itself. They are just liars. They are good liars, with the Bible in their hand. That's what black Christian apologetics are. They can't stand up to us. They want to debate us knowing that they can't stand up to us. They are more concerned about getting a clip, refurbishing the clip, and putting it out as if they won, to confuse the minds of the believers. That's what it's for.

“and his commandments are not grievous.” His commandments are not grievous. It ain't hard to do. So don't let these people shake your faith. If it's a miracle for you to wake up and be where you are today -- if you're looking at this class right now, you know how big of a miracle that is, for you to come out of the mindset of not eating chitlins on every fourth Thursday of the month of November, for you to come out of the mindset of this entertainment world and not give a damn about the Super Bowl no more, and be more concerned about waking the people up. That's a miracle. Don't let these people shake your faith with these stupid ass debates they want to get people into. Let them other Israelite camps do that; they want to debate them people because they into clickbait themselves, they into monetization themselves, they into the money. We going to keep doing what we doing. Don't let nobody shake your faith with no debate. What the Bible say, that's what it is, because we're saying what the Bible say.

They received not the love of the truth -- so what is the truth? “Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.”

Thy law is the truth. The laws of God: that's the truth. That's point blank, period. That's what it is. You can't change that.

Now go back and you'll understand what Paul is telling the church at Thessalonica: with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish, because they received not the love of the truth. They did not receive it. They wanted to stay in sin.

The debates are there to set up confusion, and “For God is not the author of confusion”. So God is not the author of confusion.

You know the difference between right and wrong. You know pork is bad for you. You know dressing like that is bad for you -- and you ain't got the right man you've been looking for yet, dressed like no hoe. That's just nasty. Been getting with one after another to the point you got five baby daddies and six kids, and the only reason it wasn't six daddies is because you had twins by one of them. That's nasty. It's time for you to change.

So the confusion is not from God. The debates trying to figure out who's right and who's wrong are there to set up confusion, and that's not what's going to wake the people up. Teaching God's laws is.

sense.text:
“Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit”. This time of the year the people want to make you feel bad because you did not go to your parents' house. Big mama came to town, Uncle Leroy came to town, everybody came to town and you wasn't there. Do not let your family make you feel bad. The scripture says beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit.

That's Christianity. They tell them that it's okay to celebrate Thanksgiving and eat unclean food, and to break the Lord's Sabbath day.

“after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.” They learned that after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world. Christ didn't tell you to do that.

precepts.why:
“My son, if thou come to serve the Lord, prepare thy soul for temptation.” So if you come into this truth and you're serving the Lord, the scripture said to prepare your soul for temptation. And that temptation is going to come from the people that so-called love you -- the people that you grew up with, the people that have raised you. That temptation going to come from them.

“Set thy heart aright” -- get your mind right. Every year you got to get your mind right, especially if you in this truth. You been here six months, a month, a year, until your family knows: hey, don't text her happy Thanksgiving or Merry Christmas. They got to know this, and you got to show it through your example. And you can do it respectfully. You don't have to disrespect nobody. Just let your light shine. Just don't answer back. They know that you didn't answer back, they know that you didn't show up. But you got to be that righteous example. Don't let them pull you, because that's what they want to do -- they want to pull you and make you feel bad because you didn't come see them.

“and constantly endure”. Get your mind right, and you got to constantly endure in this truth. Don't let nobody pull you away.

“Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable”. The Bible says be ye stedfast. Unmoveable. Don't let nobody pull you away from the truth. You left the delusional state of mind. You was in Christianity twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, some sixty years, some seventy years. Some are just now hearing the truth. Don't let nobody take you back.

“always abounding in the work of the Lord” -- always keeping the Lord's Sabbath day, always keeping the Lord's laws, always doing what the Lord say do, always doing the work of the Lord.

“forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.” Your labour, what you're doing, is not in vain. If you missed Thanksgiving, know that you're here on the Sabbath day, you're watching class, you're taking notes, you're getting ready for the Sabbath. A lot of people on their way to the Sabbath right now. Do not let that detour you. Don't let your family detour you and bring you back into that delusion of Christianity. That's what they want to do. That's Satan's job.

“Be stedfast in thy understanding”. Be stedfast in your understanding. Don't let your family sway you back into Christianity. Know that the Lord have woken you up for a reason.

“and let thy word be the same.” Let your word be the same. Don't be no hypocrite. Don't be sitting up there trying to get your people to repent all year from January all the way up until November, and then in November you go eat -- I think I'll just take one bowl of chitlins home, I'll just accept one Christmas gift. They laughing at you.

Be stedfast in what you have been awakened to in the word of God. Let your word be the same. Do not be a hypocrite.
